correctness.rationale: The decomposition is correct. With p=(e1+e2)/2 and q=(e1-e2)/2, one obtains orthogonal idempotents p^2=p, q^2=q, pq=0, pe3=e3 and qe3=0. Hence A_t=kq times pA_t, where e3 satisfies e3^2-e3-2tp=0; setting w=2e3-p gives w^2=(1+8t)p. Thus over an algebraically closed field the nonzero-discriminant case is k^3 and the zero-discriminant case is k times the dual numbers, matching the reproduced U_2^3 and U_3^3 tables. Over odd finite fields, square/zero/nonsquare discriminant gives k^3, k times dual numbers, and k times F_{q^2}, with automorphism orders 6, q-1 and 2. Fresh symbolic multiplication independently verified the idempotent and quadratic relations; the finite-field checker is corroborative only.
